records.source: The dark... the rain... it gets me excited.$l
records.translation: Ang dilim... ang ulan... nasasabik ako rito.$l

records.source: Hey, remember when we played that duet by the lake? This weather reminds me of that day.#$e#You really surprised me with that mini-harp... I never expected that. I guess that's why I like you so much.$l
records.translation: Uy, naaalala mo noong tinugtog natin ang duet na iyon sa tabi ng lawa? Ipinaaalala sa akin ng panahong ito ang araw na iyon.#$e#Talagang ginulat mo ako sa munting alpa na iyon... Hindi ko inaasahan iyon. Siguro iyon ang dahilan kung bakit gustong-gusto kita.$l

records.source: Hey! I woke up early and did some exploring on my own. I found this and it reminded me of you. [768 767 769 66 82]#$e#Think you can find something better than that? I'm not so sure!$h
records.translation: Uy! Maaga akong bumangon at mag-isang naglibot. Natagpuan ko ito at naalala kita. [768 767 769 66 82]#$e#Sa tingin mo ay may mahahanap kang mas maganda riyan? Hindi ako nakatitiyak!$h

records.source: It might be a good day to visit the caves, huh? Just be careful out there.#$e#If you go, bring a Life Elixir or two.
records.translation: Mukhang magandang araw para dalawin ang mga yungib, ano? Mag-ingat ka lang doon.#$e#Kung pupunta ka, magdala ka ng isa o dalawang Eliksir ng Buhay.

records.source: Maybe I'll boot up Journey Of The Prairie King today... one of these days I swear, I'll beat the whole game.$h
records.translation: Baka simulan ko ang Paglalakbay ng Hari ng Kapatagan ngayon... Isinusumpa ko, balang araw ay tatapusin ko ang buong laro.$h

records.source: %Abigail is lost in her music.
records.translation: %Labis na nahuhumaling si Abigail sa kaniyang musika.

records.source: The countryside looks more interesting on a day like this, don't you think?
records.translation: Mas kawili-wili ang kabukiran sa araw na tulad nito, hindi ba?

records.source: I was just gazing out into the rainswept woods... I swear I saw something darker than black shifting around the trees.$6
records.translation: Tinititigan ko lang ang kagubatang hinahampas ng ulan... Isinusumpa kong may nakita akong mas maitim pa sa itim na gumagalaw sa pagitan ng mga puno.$6

records.source: It's a good night to see a ghost...
records.translation: Magandang gabi ito para makakita ng multo...

records.source: Can you feel it? There's a stillness in the rain...
records.translation: Nararamdaman mo ba? May katahimikan sa ulan...

records.source: On nights like this, I like to turn the light down low and just listen...$8
records.translation: Sa mga gabing tulad nito, gusto kong hinaan ang ilaw at makinig lang...$8

records.source: I felt like making some soup for dinner. I hope it's not too disgusting. [199 218 219 727 730]$h
records.translation: Naisipan kong gumawa ng sopas para sa hapunan. Sana ay hindi ito masyadong nakakadiri. [199 218 219 727 730]$h

records.source: Hey! You look like you've been hard at work. Can I help you relax?^Have you been working hard? You look cute when you're a little exhausted.$h
records.translation: Uy! Mukhang nagsikap ka nang husto. Puwede ba kitang tulungang magpahinga?^Nagsikap ka ba nang husto? Kaibig-ibig ka kapag medyo pagod.$h

records.source: The sound of rain should put us right to sleep tonight.
records.translation: Dapat tayong patulugin agad ng tunog ng ulan ngayong gabi.

records.source: I always loved this place, long before you moved in. Now I can explore the farm whenever I want!$h
records.translation: Matagal ko nang mahal ang lugar na ito bago ka pa lumipat dito. Ngayon ay malilibot ko ang bukid anumang oras na gusto ko!$h

records.source: Hey, @. Heading out into the wild? I got you something...[286 287 205 732]#$e#Use that if you get into a tough spot. It should help keep you safe.
records.translation: Uy, @. Pupunta ka sa ilang? May dala ako para sa iyo...[286 287 205 732]#$e#Gamitin mo iyan kapag nalagay ka sa alanganin. Dapat makatulong itong panatilihin kang ligtas.

records.source: Heading to the mines? Hey... if you find something tasty, remember to bring me a piece!$h
records.translation: Pupunta ka sa mga Minahan? Uy... kung may makita kang masarap, tandaan mong dalhan ako ng isang piraso!$h

records.source: Hey! I'm just debating what I should do today. I'm not used to having this much freedom!
records.translation: Uy! Pinag-iisipan ko lang kung ano ang gagawin ko ngayon. Hindi ako sanay sa ganitong kalaking kalayaan!

records.source: You don't mind if I do some re-decorating now and then, do you? I'm still excited to have a place of my own to work on.
records.translation: Ayos lang sa iyo kung magpalit ako ng ilang palamuti paminsan-minsan, hindi ba? Nasasabik pa rin akong magkaroon ng sarili kong lugar na maaayos.

records.source: There's always something new happening on our farm... I love it.
records.translation: Laging may bagong nangyayari sa bukid natin... Gustong-gusto ko iyon.

records.source: I had a good day, today. There's always something interesting going on around here, if you look close enough.
records.translation: Naging maganda ang araw ko ngayon. Laging may interesanteng nangyayari rito kung pagmamasdan mo nang mabuti.

records.source: Hey! Tell me about your day. Did anything exciting happen?$h
records.translation: Uy! Ikuwento mo sa akin ang araw mo. May kapana-panabik bang nangyari?$h

records.source: I used to be a night owl, but I'm starting to enjoy the rhythm of life on the farm. It feels natural.
records.translation: Mahilig akong magpuyat noon, pero nagsisimula na akong magustuhan ang ritmo ng buhay sa bukid. Parang likas ito.

records.source: *yawn*... I'm ready to call it a night pretty soon.$h
records.translation: *hikab*... Handa na akong matulog maya-maya.$h

records.source: The sounds of the night are louder out here. I'll never stop enjoying that.
records.translation: Mas malakas ang mga tunog sa gabi rito. Hindi ako magsasawang pakinggan ang mga iyon.

records.source: Are you ready for bed soon? I turned on the electric blanket for us...$l
records.translation: Handa ka na bang matulog maya-maya? Binuksan ko na ang de-kuryenteng kumot para sa atin...$l

records.source: The soft breeze is blowing mountain air throughout the valley today. It smells like fresh pine and sage.
records.translation: Dinadala ng banayad na simoy ang hangin mula sa kabundukan sa buong lambak ngayon. Amoy sariwang pino at salbya.

records.source: Hmm... I think we've got plenty of space for outdoor slime ranching!
records.translation: Hmm... Sa tingin ko ay marami tayong lugar para mag-alaga ng mga Slime sa labas!

records.source: Make sure to keep things tidy around your Grandpa's shrine. There's something special about it, I can feel it.
records.translation: Tiyaking panatilihing maayos ang paligid ng dambana ng Lolo mo. May kakaibang katangian iyon, nararamdaman ko.

records.source: It's pretty cool that we have a cave on our property. It's something I always dreamed about.$h
records.translation: Ang astig na mayroon tayong yungib sa lupain natin. Matagal ko na itong pinapangarap.$h

records.source: I always forget to put some snacks in my pocket. *rumble*$h
records.translation: Lagi kong nalilimutang maglagay ng meryenda sa bulsa ko. *kumalam*$h

records.source: I'm just going to hang out here, okay?#$e#There's a lot of interesting bugs and things out here. *chuckle*$h
records.translation: Tatambay lang ako rito, ayos lang?#$e#Maraming kawili-wiling kulisap at iba pang bagay dito. *humagikgik*$h

records.source: I'm going in to town today, just so you know. I need to stretch these legs a bit.
records.translation: Pupunta ako sa bayan ngayon, para alam mo lang. Kailangan kong iunat nang kaunti ang mga binting ito.

records.source: Hey! Did you have a good day? Mine went well. It was refreshing to take a walk.$h
records.translation: Uy! Naging maganda ba ang araw mo? Naging maayos naman ang araw ko. Nakagiginhawang maglakad-lakad.$h

records.source: I can't believe I'm a "mom"... life is weird.$h
records.translation: Hindi ako makapaniwalang isa na akong “nanay”... kakaiba ang buhay.$h

records.source: I already gave %kid1 and %kid2 their chocolate cereal. They were screaming!
records.translation: Naibigay ko na kina %kid1 at %kid2 ang cereal na tsokolate nila. Nagsisisigaw sila!

records.source: I had a dream that %kid2 will grow up to be a famous monster hunter. I've already been thinking about a little armor set.
records.translation: Napanaginipan kong paglaki ni %kid2 ay magiging sikat siyang mangangaso ng halimaw. Iniisip ko na ang isang munting baluti para sa kanya.

records.source: A cool old house, a couple kids, and an amazing farm. I never thought I'd come this far... but, hey! Our lives are just getting started.$h
records.translation: Astig na lumang bahay, dalawang anak, at kahanga-hangang bukid. Hindi ko inakalang makararating ako nang ganito kalayo... pero, uy! Nagsisimula pa lang ang buhay natin.$h

records.source: Did you hear that? Sometimes I'm convinced this house is haunted.$u
records.translation: Narinig mo ba iyon? Minsan ay kumbinsido akong may multo sa bahay na ito.$u

records.source: Welwick's horoscope predicted great things for me today. I feel really motivated!
records.translation: Hinulaan ng horoscope ni Welwick na may magagandang mangyayari sa akin ngayon. Talagang ganado ako!

records.source: I can't even remember the last time I dyed my hair... I swear, it never fades from this color...
records.translation: Hindi ko na maalala kung kailan ko huling tinina ang buhok ko... Isinusumpa ko, hindi kumukupas ang kulay na ito...

records.source: I'm glad I owned a heavy pair of boots before moving in. It's hard to imagine tip-toeing around the mud in sneakers.$h
records.translation: Natutuwa akong mayroon akong matibay na pares ng bota bago lumipat dito. Mahirap isiping maglakad nang patiyad sa putik gamit ang sapatos na goma.$h

records.source: I was just admiring the mermaid's pendant you gave me... I'll proudly wear this to my grave.$l
records.translation: Hinahangaan ko lang ang Palawit ng Sirena na ibinigay mo sa akin... Buong pagmamalaki ko itong isusuot hanggang sa libingan.$l

records.source: Hey. I know you're smart, but I still worry about you sometimes. The world is full of monsters.$6#$e#Just promise me you'll be careful. I don't want to lose you.
records.translation: Uy. Alam kong matalino ka, pero nag-aalala pa rin ako sa iyo minsan. Punô ng mga halimaw ang mundo.$6#$e#Ipangako mo lang na mag-iingat ka. Ayaw kitang mawala.

records.source: @? I just want to say that I appreciate all the hard work you do for us. I'm really proud of you.$l
records.translation: @? Gusto ko lang sabihing pinahahalagahan ko ang lahat ng pagsisikap mo para sa atin. Talagang ipinagmamalaki kita.$l

records.source: I hope you'll still like me when I'm old and shriveled. It's going to happen some day!
records.translation: Sana ay gusto mo pa rin ako kapag matanda at kulubot na ako. Mangyayari iyon balang-araw!

records.source: Do you think your Grandpa would be proud of us?
records.translation: Sa tingin mo ba ay ipagmamalaki tayo ng Lolo mo?

records.source: I wonder how the old shop is doing? I should visit my parents again soon.
records.translation: Kumusta na kaya ang lumang tindahan? Dapat kong dalawin ulit ang mga magulang ko sa lalong madaling panahon.

records.source: If you moved on to the spirit world, I'd set up a little shrine for you next to Grandpa's.
records.translation: Kung pumanaw ka at napunta sa daigdig ng mga espiritu, magtatayo ako ng munting dambana para sa iyo sa tabi ng dambana ni Lolo.

records.source: No matter how much we clean, the house keeps getting dirty again.#$e#I guess farms are kind of dirty.
records.translation: Gaano man natin linisin, paulit-ulit na dumurumi ang bahay.#$e#Siguro ay medyo marumi talaga ang mga bukid.

records.source: I wonder if we'll live here our entire lives? I might get bored.
records.translation: Iniisip ko kung dito ba tayo titira habambuhay. Baka magsawa ako.

records.source: I used to be special to you, your best friend... now you only seem to put up with me when I make a hot dinner.$s
records.translation: Natatangi ako noon para sa iyo, ang matalik mong kaibigan... ngayon ay parang tinitiis mo lang ako kapag naghahanda ako ng mainit na hapunan.$s

records.source: You've been so cold to me lately... What's wrong with you? You're acting like a bog spirit...$s
records.translation: Napakalamig ng pakikitungo mo sa akin nitong huli... Ano ang problema mo? Para kang espiritu ng latian...$s

records.source: I wonder if I could've done better... I was very good friends with Sebastian before we met. He was probably the one...$s
records.translation: Iniisip ko kung may mas mabuti sana akong pinili... Napakalapit namin ni Sebastian bago tayo nagkita. Siguro ay siya talaga ang para sa akin...$s

records.source: So, do you have any big plans for the new year?
records.translation: Aba, may malalaki ka bang plano para sa bagong taon?

records.source: Hey, the egg festival is tomorrow. I'm sorry, but I won't go easy on you because we're married!$h#$e#I plan on winning that egg hunt. Go ahead and try to beat me.
records.translation: Uy, Pista ng Itlog bukas. Pasensiya na, pero hindi kita pagbibigyan dahil lang kasal tayo!$h#$e#Balak kong manalo sa paghahanap ng itlog na iyon. Sige, subukan mo akong talunin.

records.source: Do you have any new year's resolutions? I'm trying to lose a few pounds around the middle.$h
records.translation: May mga pangako ka ba para sa bagong taon? Sinisikap kong bawasan nang kaunti ang taba sa baywang ko.$h

records.source: I get sunburnt very easily, so I need to be careful this time of year.#$e#I hope you like me pale!$h
records.translation: Napakadali kong masunog sa araw, kaya kailangan kong mag-ingat sa panahong ito.#$e#Sana ay gusto mo akong maputla!$h

records.source: Make sure you don't get a heat stroke, my love.#$e#Drink plenty of water and don't overwork yourself.
records.translation: Tiyakin mong hindi ka tamaan ng heatstroke, mahal ko.#$e#Uminom ng maraming tubig at huwag pagurin nang sobra ang sarili mo.

records.source: Sorry about the smell... I was sweating all night in the heat.
records.translation: Pasensiya na sa amoy... Buong gabi akong pinagpawisan sa init.

records.source: It's summer... that means the house is full of flies.#$e#Don't worry, I'll take care of them. It's fun!$h
records.translation: Tag-init na... ibig sabihin, punô ng langaw ang bahay.#$e#Huwag kang mag-alala, ako na ang bahala sa mga iyon. Masayang hulihin sila!$h

records.source: Ah... fall. This might be my favorite time of year. The colors really complement my hair, don't you think?
records.translation: Ah... taglagas. Baka ito ang paborito kong panahon ng taon. Talagang bumabagay sa buhok ko ang mga kulay, hindi ba?

records.source: The scent is unmistakable... mushroom, rotting leaves, pumpkin. It's fall, alright. Isn't it lovely?
records.translation: Hindi maipagkakamali ang halimuyak... kabute, nabubulok na mga dahon, kalabasa. Taglagas na nga. Hindi ba kaibig-ibig?

records.source: Can we grow giant pumpkins this season? Please, honey?$h
records.translation: Puwede ba tayong magpatubo ng mga dambuhalang kalabasa ngayong panahon? Pakiusap, mahal?$h

records.source: Honey... you're worth more to me than a chest full of quartz.#$e#Now, a chest full of amethyst? Hmm... I'd have to think about that one.$h
records.translation: Mahal... mas mahalaga ka sa akin kaysa sa isang baul na punô ng quartz.#$e#Pero isang baul na punô ng ametista? Hmm... Kailangan kong pag-isipan iyon.$h

records.source: I actually like the cold weather. It just gives me an excuse to get cozy!$h
records.translation: Sa totoo lang, gusto ko ang malamig na panahon. Nagbibigay lang ito sa akin ng dahilan para magpakumportable!$h

records.source: It's fun to explore the valley in winter! Everything is so different under a blanket of snow. And so quiet...
records.translation: Masayang libutin ang lambak sa taglamig! Ibang-iba ang lahat sa ilalim ng kumot ng niyebe. At napakatahimik...

records.source: I may like the colder seasons, but by the end I'm always glad to see spring arrive.
records.translation: Maaaring mas gusto ko ang malalamig na panahon, pero sa huli ay lagi akong natutuwang dumating ang tagsibol.

records.source: Oh man... I could go for some chocolate cake.
records.translation: Naku... Gustong-gusto ko ngayon ng Keyk na Tsokolate.

records.source: Do I smell pumpkin on you? Maybe I'm just dreaming...$h
records.translation: Amoy kalabasa ka ba? Baka nananaginip lang ako...$h

records.source: Remember when we played 'Prairie King' together in my room, so long ago? Those were good times.$h
records.translation: Naaalala mo noong magkasama nating nilaro ang “Hari ng Kapatagan” sa kuwarto ko, napakatagal na? Masasayang panahon iyon.$h

records.source: #$c .5#I got up a little before you and fed David Jr. He's very active this morning.#$e#I hope you don't mind the guinea pig smell.
records.translation: #$c .5#Bumangon ako nang bahagyang mas maaga kaysa sa iyo at pinakain si David Jr. Napakaaktibo niya ngayong umaga.#$e#Sana ay ayos lang sa iyo ang amoy ng dagang-gini.
